overview.title: Overview
overview.noClicksYet: No clicks yet. Share your links and come back.
overview.emptySub: Create your first short link and watch the zeros roll in.

table.title: Links
table.emptySub: Try another search, tag or status.
table.emptyAllSub: Paste a long URL anywhere on this screen or create the first one. Every click is counted with country, device and referrer.

new.title: New link
new.sub: One, many, or everything you had on Bitly.
new.slugReserved: Reserved word. Use it on a custom domain.
new.formDesc: Paste the long URL. The slug is optional: leave it empty and one is generated.
new.formNote: You can change everything later in the link settings.
new.slugHelp: Leave empty to generate one. 2 to 32 characters: letters, numbers, - and _.
new.advancedHint: Title, tags, UTM, redirect, expiry, password
new.ogHelp: How the link looks on WhatsApp, X or Slack. Empty uses the destination page preview.
new.forwardParamsLabel: Pass query parameters to the destination
new.forwardParamsHelp: Opening the short link with ?utm_source=newsletter adds it to the destination. If the destination already has that parameter, the one on the short link wins.
new.expiredUrlHelp: Where visitors go once the link expires or reaches its click limit. Leave it empty to show the default page.
new.utmSyncHelp: Changing a field updates the destination URL, and editing the URL updates these fields.

detail.archiveDesc: Stops redirecting. Analytics are kept and you can unarchive it any time.
detail.deleteDesc: Deletes the link and all its analytics. This cannot be undone.
detail.noClicksCountry: No clicks from that country in this range.
detail.routeBranches: {n, plural, one {+# routed destination} other {+# routed destinations}}
detail.slugHelp: Changing it breaks the old short link.
detail.advancedHint: UTM, redirect, expiry, limit, password, preview
detail.unarchiveDesc: Starts redirecting to the destination again.
detail.emptyBody: Share <data>{short}</data> and clicks show up here.

bulk.title: Many links at once
bulk.sub: Up to 200 rows, one per line. Add a slug and a title after the URL, or leave them out and the slug is generated.
bulk.count: {n, plural, =0 {No URLs yet} one {# URL} other {# URLs}}
bulk.rowsHelp: Each line is a URL, or url, slug, title (commas or tabs, as copied from a spreadsheet). The title can contain commas.
bulk.previewSummary: {ok, plural, one {# row ready} other {# rows ready}}, {bad, plural, =0 {none with problems} one {# with a problem} other {# with problems}}. Slug availability is checked when creating.

settings.title: Settings
settings.demoDesc: Demo mode is on: everyone is the same demo user. In production you sign in with Google.
settings.name: Name
settings.apiKeysDesc: Use a key with the public API: Authorization: Bearer zs_…
settings.keyWarning: Copy it now. You won't see it again. Ever.

aiUsage.title: AI usage
aiUsage.sub: Tokens used by AI features (chat bot) in this workspace this month.
aiUsage.notConfigured: AI is not configured on this server. Set AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY (or deploy on Vercel with AI Gateway) to enable AI features.
aiUsage.quotaNote: When the free quota runs out, AI features pause until next month and fall back to non-AI behavior.

settings.scopesHint: What this key can do. Keys created before scopes have all of them.

gone.notfoundSub: It never existed, was deleted or archived. Like all dead software.
gone.expiredSub: It reached its expiration date and no longer redirects.
gone.limitSub: This link already served all the clicks it was allowed.
gone.passwordSub: You need the password to pass through.
gone.blockedSub: Its destination was reported as phishing or malware, so we stopped the redirect to protect you.

domains.title: Domains
domains.desc: Add it, create the DNS record, then verify. HTTPS is set up automatically.
domains.dnsHelp: Create these records at your DNS provider: the TXT proves the domain is yours. Changes can take a few minutes.
domains.name: Name
domains.verifiedNow: Verified. You can now pick this domain when creating links.
domains.notYet: DNS isn't pointing here yet. Try again in a few minutes.

errors.invalid_hostname: That isn't a valid domain (e.g. go.example.com).
errors.domain_taken: That domain is already in use.
errors.provider_error: Couldn't register the domain with the hosting provider. Try again.
errors.has_links: This domain still has links. Move or delete them first.
errors.too_many_pending: You have 5 domains waiting for verification. Verify or remove one first.
errors.rate_limited: Too many domains added. Wait a while and try again.
errors.domain_pending_elsewhere: Another workspace added this domain and has not verified it. To take it, create a TXT record named {name} with the value {value} and add it again.
errors.unsafe_url: That URL is reported as phishing or malware, or its domain is blocked.

domains.txtMissing: We can't see the TXT record yet. Check its name and value; DNS can take a few minutes.
domains.emptyBody: Until then, your links use the zerosoft domain.
domains.notFoundPlaceholder: Where an unknown go.yourcompany.com/slug should go (optional)
domains.expiredPlaceholder: Default for expired links without their own redirect (optional)
domains.redirectsHelp: Leave a field empty to use the default page.

export.title: Your data
export.desc: Download every link. CSV has one row per link; JSON also includes every click (referrer, country, device). No hostages.

import.title: Import from Bitly
import.desc: Bring your links with their back-halves. If you verified the same custom domain here first, they keep working as-is once you move the DNS.
import.tokenHelp: In Bitly, go to Settings > API > Generate token. We use it once and don't store it.
import.csvHelp: In Bitly, Links > Export (or any CSV with a long URL column).
import.truncated: Only the first 2,000 were imported; run it again for the rest.
import.renamed: {n} got a new back-half (it was taken)

errors.bitly_no_group: That Bitly account has no group.
errors.csv_no_url_column: We couldn't find a long URL column in that CSV.
errors.rate_limited: Too many imports. Wait a few minutes.

tokenHelps.bitly: In Bitly, go to Settings > API > Generate token. We use it once and don't store it.
tokenHelps.rebrandly: In Rebrandly, go to Account > API keys and create one. We use it once and don't store it.
tokenHelps.shortio: In Short.io, go to Integrations & API and create a secret key. We bring the links of all your domains. We use it once and don't store it.

bio.sub: One page with your links at {host}/@{handle}. Each button goes through the short link, so clicks show up in your analytics.
bio.linksHint: Check the links to show and order them. Password-protected, archived and expired links are hidden.
bio.error: Check the fields (avatar must be an https URL).
bio.searchPlaceholder: Search other links by title, slug or URL

themes.auto: Follow the visitor's light or dark mode

bio.previewEmpty: Pick links to show them here.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.sub: All your links together. Dates in {tz}.
analytics.emptyBody: Share a link and clicks show up here.
analytics.conversionsEmpty: No leads or sales in this range. Turn on conversion tracking on a link and report them from your site.

targeting.title: Routing
targeting.hint: Send each visitor to a different destination by country, device or A/B variant. With no rules, the link goes to its URL.
targeting.rulesHint: The first matching rule wins. With no countries or devices, it applies to everyone.
targeting.abHint: Splits visits by weight. Each visitor always sees the same variant.
targeting.deepHint: Tries to open your app. If it is not installed, goes to the fallback (store or web).
targeting.countriesInvalid: Use two-letter country codes (AR, US, BR).
targeting.incompleteRow: Every rule and A/B variant needs a destination URL. Fill it in or remove the row.
targeting.clearConfirm: Remove all rules, A/B variants and deep links from this link?
targeting.ipadNote: iPads with Safari identify as a Mac, so they get the desktop destination.

qr.logoHint: PNG, JPG or WebP up to 200 KB. With a logo, the QR uses high error correction.
qr.logoTooBig: The logo is larger than 200 KB.
qr.lowContrast: Low contrast: some scanners will not read it.
qr.scansNote: The QR points to {url}: scans are counted apart from clicks.
qr.loadError: Couldn't load the QR. Reload the page.
qr.designDesc: Colors, modules and logo. Saved for every download.
qr.templateLimit: This workspace already has 50 templates. Delete one first.
qr.templateApplied: Applied “{name}”. Save to keep it on this QR.
qr.label: Frame text
qr.saveTemplate: Save this design as a template
qr.templateHelp: Templates are shared with your workspace and apply to any link's QR.

states.errorBody: Try again. If it keeps failing, tell us from Feedback.

utmTemplates.removeConfirm: Delete the template "{name}"? Links that used it keep their UTM.

errors.name_taken: A template with that name already exists.

errors.empty_template: Fill at least one UTM field.
errors.forbidden: Only whoever created the template or an admin can delete it.

comments.title: Comments
comments.help: Internal notes for your team. They never show on the link or in the API.
comments.label: New comment
comments.placeholder: Who asked for this link, which campaign it belongs to, what to keep in mind

folders.title: Folders
folders.pageDesc: Group links in folders and choose who can view or edit each one. Owners and admins can always edit everything.
folders.addDesc: Members get the default access. You can change it for specific people afterwards.
folders.name: Name
folders.emptyBody: Links without a folder stay visible and editable for the whole workspace.
folders.linksCount: {n, plural, =0 {No links} one {# link} other {# links}}
folders.removeConfirm: {n, plural, =0 {Delete the folder {name}?} one {Delete the folder {name}? Its link stays, without a folder.} other {Delete the folder {name}? Its # links stay, without a folder.}}
folders.adminsHelp: Owners and admins can always edit. People with view access see the links and their analytics, but can’t change them.

errors.name_taken: There’s already a folder with that name.
errors.invalid_member: That person isn’t in the workspace.
errors.forbidden: Only workspace admins can manage folders.

share.title: Public analytics page
share.desc: A read-only page with totals, days and breakdowns. It shows referrer domains only, with no visit log. Anyone with the link can open it until you revoke it.
share.revokeConfirm: Revoke this page? The link stops working right away.

errors.too_many: This already has 10 public pages. Revoke one to create another.
errors.not_found: That link or tag no longer exists.
errors.forbidden: Only workspace admins can share a tag.

share.footer: Read-only page shared from zerosoft. It shows aggregated visits only.

conversions.title: Conversions
conversions.toggleHelp: Each visit gets a click id (?zs_id=) on the destination, so your site can report sign-ups and sales back to this link.
conversions.waiting: No conversions yet. Add the tracking script and report leads from your server, as shown in Conversions settings.
conversions.howDesc: Measure which links bring sign-ups and revenue, like Dub Conversions.
conversions.step1: Turn on “Track leads and sales” on a link. Visits arrive at your site with ?zs_id=<click id>.
conversions.step2: Add this script to your site. It keeps the click id in a cookie on your own domain for 90 days.
conversions.step3: When someone signs up or pays, send the click id and your customer id to the API, or connect Stripe or Shopify.
conversions.snippetHelp: The script only reads ?zs_id and stores it on your domain. It sends nothing to zerosoft.
conversions.apiDesc: From your server, with an API key that has the links:write scope. Sales use amounts in cents.
conversions.apiKeys: Create the key in API keys. Repeating a lead for the same customer, or a sale with the same invoiceId, does not count twice.
conversions.stripeDesc: Paid Checkout sessions and invoices become sales of the link that brought the customer.
conversions.stripeConnect: Use the workspace Stripe connection in Integrations, and pass the click id when you create the Checkout session (or metadata.zs_customer_id with the id you used for the lead). Later invoices of that customer count too.
conversions.publishableHelp: It goes inside your mobile app. It only identifies this workspace for deferred deep links and is not an API key.
conversions.rotateBody: The current key stops working right away. Update your app with the new one.
conversions.deferredDesc: When someone taps a link to your app without having it, they install it and the app asks which link brought them on its first launch.

cloak.toggle: Keep the short link in the address bar
cloak.help: The destination opens inside your domain (link cloaking). Some sites block being shown this way; test it after saving.
cloak.needsDomain: Available on links of a custom domain.
cloak.conversionsWarning: With cloaking the destination runs inside an iframe, where browsers block its cookies: leads and sales from this link will not be attributed.

safety.blockedBanner: This link is blocked: its destination was reported as {reason}. Visitors see a warning instead of the destination. Change the destination to unblock it.

reason.credentials: a URL that hides its real domain
reason.mixed_script: a domain that imitates another one with look-alike letters

events.title: Events
events.sub: Clicks, QR scans, leads and sales as they happen.
events.empty: No events yet. Open one of your short links and it shows up here.

ai.title: Ask about your links
ai.label: Question about these analytics
ai.placeholder: Which link brought the most clicks from Brazil?
ai.suggest2: How did this period compare with the previous one?
ai.suggest3: Where does my traffic come from?

errors.ai_disabled: AI is not set up on this workspace.
errors.quota_exceeded: This workspace used its AI quota for the month.
errors.rate_limited: Too many questions. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.ai_failed: The answer couldn't be generated. Try again.
errors.invalid_input: Write a question of up to 500 characters.

activity.title: Activity
activity.desc: Who created, changed, archived or deleted each link, and what changed.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.desc: Get Link events in Slack, send them to Zapier or Make, and attribute Stripe payments to your links.
integrations.disconnectBody: Link stops sending or receiving events from it. You can connect it again later.

errors.invalid_shopify_secret: Paste the signing secret shown in Shopify (16 characters or more).
errors.invalid_segment_key: Paste the write key of a Segment source (letters and numbers).

shopify.name: Shopify
shopify.desc: Paid orders become sales of the link that brought the buyer.
shopify.help: In Shopify, go to Settings > Notifications > Webhooks, create an “Order payment” webhook in JSON and copy the signing secret shown below the list.
shopify.endpointHelp: Paste this URL in the “Order payment” webhook. Orders that arrived with ?zs_id= count as sales.

segment.name: Segment
segment.desc: Send Link Clicked, Lead Created and Sale Created events to a Segment source.
segment.help: In Segment, create an HTTP API source and copy its write key.
segment.connectedHelp: Each click, lead and sale goes to Segment as a track event, with country and device but no IP address.

mcp.title: MCP server for AI agents
mcp.desc: Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor can create links and answer questions about your analytics.
mcp.help: Add this URL as a remote MCP server with an API key from API keys (links:read to read, links:write to create and edit).

cards.slack: Post new short links, leads and sales to a channel.
cards.stripe: Count paid Checkout sessions and invoices as sales of the link that brought the customer.
cards.zapier: Send link, lead and sale events to a Zapier catch hook.
cards.make: Send link, lead and sale events to a Make webhook.
